title: docs(skills): objectstack-formula evals exercise label(record.kind), and refuse it in a predicate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi91AMradEff12Xm38NWmyrwr)_

Fixes #26760

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`objectstack-formula` 技能的 eval 文件新增两例 —— 正例(用 select 字段拼记录名,须写 `label(record.kind)`,禁止硬编码标签的三元)、反例(校验规则与 `visibleWhen` 里禁止出现 `label(`,它在谓词里会报错并中止写入);同文件删掉 4 句只是复述自身 `must_not_contain` 断言的话(212 字节),token 棘轮行按实测 1046 → 1352 上调,附一条 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。
- **为什么改**:#26755 在 SKILL.md 教了 `label(record.f)`,但没有任何 eval 检查 agent 真会用它,也没有 eval 拦住把它写进校验谓词(校验谓词不可求值 = 每次写入都失败)。
- **风险与回滚**:只动已发布技能包的 eval 数据与棘轮上限,无运行时代码;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json`(case 6、7 与 case 1/2/3/5 的删句),其次 `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 的新行注释(算术),最后 changeset。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期看到 `cel-predicates-formulas.json is 1352 tokens (ceiling 1352; headroom 0)` 与整体 ✓。
- **需要你做的**:批准本 PR(`skills/**` 为 Tier H,需 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 批准后由席位落地)。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json`** — two cases join the five:
  - **Case 6 (positive).** Prompt: name `contract_version` records by version number and the `kind` select so a zh-CN reader sees `v2 · 清稿` and an en-US reader `v2 · Clean`. Expected: a `type: 'formula'` `nameField` spelled `F`'v' + string(record.version_no) + ' · ' + label(record.kind)``; `label()` takes exactly `record.FIELD` of a select field, reads the option label in the reader's locale, `''` for null. `must_contain: ["label(record.kind)", "F`"]`; `must_not_contain: ["== 'clean' ?", "{record."]` — the hard-coded label ternary the card describes.
  - **Case 7 (negative, per the seat note on the card).** Prompt: refuse a `contract_version` save unless `kind` is the clean copy, and show `signed_at` only once `status` is signed. Expected: predicates over the STORED value — a `script` validation `P`record.kind != 'clean'`` (it fails when true) and `visibleWhen: P`record.status == 'signed'``; the `label` macro evaluates only in a formula field and faults in a validation, `visibleWhen` or hook predicate, aborting every write. `must_contain: ["record.kind", "visibleWhen", "P`"]`; `must_not_contain: ["label(", "{record."]`.
  - **Paid down first.** Four sentences in cases 1, 2, 3 and 5 restated their own `must_not_contain` assertions and are cut, 212 bytes = 53 units: case 1 "Field references are bare `record.FIELD`, never brace-wrapped." (asserted by `{record.`), case 2 "Uses `'draft'` single quotes and bare `record.` references." (`{record.`; the `'draft'` spelling stays in the expression), case 3 "No `ISCHANGED()` function." (`ISCHANGED(`), case 5 "Canonical property names only — never `conditionalRequired`." (`conditionalRequired:`). Every other sentence carries a fact (why a guard is needed, what a shape stores, which gate refuses) and stays; every assertion stays.
- **`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`** — the file's row rises AT the measurement, 1046 → 1352, headroom 0, with the arithmetic in its comment under the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」: 1046 − 53 (the cut) = 993; + 1438 bytes = 359 units (the two cases) = 1352.
- **`.changeset/26760-formula-label-eval.md`** — `@objectstack/skills` patch (the package's `dist` is built from `skills/**`, so the bundle publishes).

**Behaviour the cases pin is read off `origin/main` `8b276385`, not invented.** `packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts` `bindOptionLabel`: `label` is a macro taking exactly `record.FIELD`; `optionLabelOf` answers `''` for null and THROWS when the evaluation context carries no `optionLabels` — which is what a validation, visibility or hook predicate's context is (only the data engine's formula-field reads pin the map, per the #26755 changeset), so the engine reports `{ ok: false, kind: 'runtime' }` and the write is aborted. `packages/formula/src/option-label.test.ts` pins both ("refuses at run time when the context carries no option labels — never the stored value"; "compiles the one argument shape and refuses every other"). `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx` § "Record name from an option label" says the same for predicates: "fails loudly instead of comparing against a label; compare the stored value there".

### Readings (`skills/**` touched)

| Reading | Before | After |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` lines | 55 | 75 |
| `evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` tokens (`ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`) | 1046 (4181 B) | 1352 (5407 B) |
| whole package, sum of all `skills/*/SKILL.md` lines | 4606 | 4606 |
| whole package, sum of all `skills/*/SKILL.md` tokens | 56132 (224526 B) | 56132 (224526 B) |
| ratchet row for the file | 1046 | 1352 (headroom 0) |

No `SKILL.md` moves; the net addition is +306 units in one eval file, paid first by the 53-unit cut and then raised at the measurement.

## Tests

No runtime code changes. The eval file is read by no runner in this repository; `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is its only reader and is in the gate list below. JSON parses (`JSON.parse` over the file at head, 7 cases); every `must_contain` string is absent from the same case's `must_not_contain` and present in its `expected_output`; in cases 6 and 7 no `must_not_contain` string appears in the `expected_output`.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's "hard-coded label ternary" is pinned as the literal `== 'clean' ?` (the stored value the prompt names, compared and branched on); a ternary over another spelling would pass `must_not_contain`, and the `must_contain` of `label(record.kind)` is what carries the teaching.
- Case 7's expected output spells the macro as "the `label` macro" rather than `label()` so the ideal answer itself does not carry the string the case refuses (the same contradiction case 3 had on `main`, `ISCHANGED()` inside its own refusal, is gone at this head: the paid-down cut removed that sentence).
- `check:skill-docs` / `check:skill-refs` / `check:skill-examples` read `SKILL.md`, `references/` and rule code fences, not eval JSON; the derived gate list below does not name them, consistent with that.

## Verification

Gate list derived at head with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (60 commands; the model tier line reads MANDATORY, `skills/**` clause ①, no one-line exit), each run with stdin closed, reconciled with `--ran`. Readings follow in the os-dev-report comment on the card.
